title: Age Calculator
aboutText: Determining exact age manually can be tricky due to varying month lengths and leap years. This free online Age Calculator computes your exact age in years, months, and days based on your date of birth and the current system date.
step1: Click on the date picker input above.
step2: Select your year, month, and day of birth from the calendar.
step4: View your exact chronological age broken down into years, months, and days instantly.
faq1Q: Does this tool account for leap years?
faq1A: Yes, the calculation automatically considers varying days in February during leap years to provide accurate results.
faq2Q: Is my date of birth saved or tracked?
faq2A: No, all processing happens locally inside your web browser. No personal data is recorded or sent to remote servers.
